title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: when the telex full-set surrender count is zero
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Bills of Lading and Transport Documents product settles the figure written as the number of originals on a full-set surrender at the origin office for a telex release.

## Formal clause

1. Originals are counted only on a document type whose tier offers telex release, and only while the booking the document covers counts as on board under its recorded status.
2. When both hold, the number written is the reconciled balance of originals of the set in force still in circulation.
3. Otherwise the number is zero.
4. The number is a whole number of original documents.

## Truth table

| Tier offers telex release | Booking counts as on board | Number written on the surrender |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Reconciled balance of originals in circulation |
| Yes | No | Zero |
| No | Yes | Zero |
| No | No | Zero |

## Hypothetical illustration

For illustration only: a document with a reconciled balance of 3 originals, on a tier offering telex release, with the booking shown as loaded, gives 3. The same history on a tier that does not offer telex release gives zero.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** the count follows the history balance on every tier. **Correct basis:** on a tier without telex release the count is zero, whatever the history shows.
- **Wrong reading:** part of an original may be written. **Correct basis:** only a whole number of original documents is written.
